headword: {大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}

definitions.explanation: A consumer co-operative association operated on university campuses in Japan. Run by and for students and faculty, providing discounted textbooks, stationery, food services, travel arrangements, and other student necessities.

examples.japanese: {教科書|きょうかしょ}は{大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}で{買|か}える。
examples.english: Textbooks can be bought at the university co-op.

examples.japanese: {大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}の{食堂|しょくどう}は{安|やす}くて{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: The university co-op cafeteria is popular because it's cheap.

examples.japanese: {入学|にゅうがく}したら{大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}に{加入|かにゅう}すると、{教科書|きょうかしょ}や{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}が{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}で{購入|こうにゅう}できる。
examples.english: If you join the university co-op after enrollment, you can purchase textbooks and stationery at discounted prices.

notes:
Short for {大学生活協同組合|だいがくせいかつきょうどうくみあい} (university consumer co-operative association). Nearly all Japanese universities have a {生協|せいきょう}, and joining is a standard part of the enrollment process for new students.

The co-op provides a wide range of services beyond just a bookstore: cafeterias, travel agencies, insurance, apartment finding, and graduation ceremony services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}に{加入|かにゅう}する: to join the university co-op
- {大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}の{書籍|しょせき}コーナー: the co-op bookstore section
- {大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}の{食堂|しょくどう}: the co-op cafeteria
- {大学生協|だいがくせいきょう}で{注文|ちゅうもん}する: to order through the co-op

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生協|せいきょう}: co-op — the shortened general form, also used for non-university co-ops
- {購買|こうばい}: school store, PX — a simpler campus store, often at elementary or high schools
- {学食|がくしょく}: campus cafeteria — the dining hall specifically
